title: docs: CONTRIBUTING_<LANG> fixes
body:
The CONTRIBUTING_GO.md and CONTRIBUTING_RUST.md files were removed in 8c8acf4, but they were still linked in the README.

This PR recreates the Golang file and links it to the project wide file.

comments.body: Or we can just remove the Golang file as well if you don't like it :D

Yeah, I figured dropping the file would make more sense. On a related note, since the other files (security, coc, contributing) also point upstream, would you be in favor of replacing those with direct links as well? I can see there may be some value in keeping them for the cases where someone browses the file tree before getting to the README, but I'm indifferent either way.

@Luap99
